passages.text: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them, saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of the families from the clan of Gilead came forward.
Gilead was the son of Machir.
Machir was the son of Manasseh.
These men belonged to the clans of Joseph.
They approached Moses.
They also came before the leaders of Israel.
These leaders were the heads of the Israelite families.
The family heads spoke to Moses and the leaders.
They said, “The LORD commanded you, my lord, to give the land to the Israelites as an inheritance by lot.
The LORD also commanded you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־ גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַנְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִי֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽאדֹנִי֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽיהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֗ת אֶֽת־ נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלָפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖ינוּ לִבְנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites divided the land among the tribes by inheritance.
The daughters of Zelophehad received an inheritance from their father.
If these daughters marry men from another tribe of Israel, their inheritance will leave their father's tribe.
Their inheritance will join the tribe of their husbands.
Our fathers' portion will lose that inheritance.
Our tribe's allotted share will become smaller.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיוּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒ וְנִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָן֙ מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִגֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites celebrated a special year called the Jubilee.
During the Jubilee, land returned to its original owners.
If the daughters of Zelophehad married men from another tribe, their land would go to their husbands' tribe.
Their inheritance would then become part of that other tribe's land.
Our fathers' tribe would lose that portion of land.
The inheritance would be taken away from our tribe and added to the tribe where the daughters married.
passages.original: וְאִם־ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַיֹּבֵל֮ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִֽנַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽן׃

passages.text: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
Moses gave a command to the Israelites.
Moses spoke by the word of the LORD.
Moses said, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph is correct.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר כֵּ֛ן מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף דֹּבְרִֽים׃

passages.text: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command about the daughters of Zelophehad.
The daughters of Zelophehad are Israelite women who inherited land from their father.
The LORD said they may marry anyone they choose.
But they must marry within a clan of their father's tribe.
This rule keeps their inheritance within their own tribe.
passages.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת צְלָפְחָד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְנָשִׁ֑ים אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
No inheritance in Israel may move from one tribe to another tribe.
Each Israelite must keep the inheritance of his father's tribe.
This rule keeps every family's land within its own tribe.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִמַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל־ מַטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔יו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
passages.sermon:
Every daughter in Israel who receives an inheritance must follow this rule.
She must marry a man from a clan within her father’s tribe.
This rule applies to all tribes of Israel.
This rule keeps the inheritance in the family line.
Each Israelite will keep the inheritance of his fathers.
passages.original: וְכָל־ בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
passages.sermon:
God gave land to each tribe of Israel.
Each tribe received its own inheritance.
No one may transfer inheritance from one tribe to another.
Each tribe must keep its own inheritance.
The people of Israel must keep the inheritance of their fathers.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִסֹּ֧ב נַחֲלָ֛ה מִמַּטֶּ֖ה לְמַטֶּ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר כִּי־ אִישׁ֙ בְּנַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command to Moses.
The command was about the daughters of Zelophehad.
The daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the LORD’s command.
They did exactly as the LORD told Moses.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנ֥וֹת צְלָפְחָֽד׃

passages.text: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
passages.sermon: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah were daughters of Zelophehad.\r\nThey married men who were their cousins on their father's side.
passages.original: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחָגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד לִבְנֵ֥י דֹדֵיהֶ֖ן לְנָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
passages.sermon:
The daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah.
They were daughters of Zelophehad.
Zelophehad belonged to the tribe of Manasseh.
Manasseh was a son of Joseph.
These daughters married men from the clans of Manasseh.
They married their cousins on their father’s side.
Their inheritance stayed within their father’s tribe.
Their land remained with the clan of their father.
passages.original: מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים וַתְּהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַל־ מַטֵּ֖ה מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֲבִיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave commandments and ordinances to the Israelites.
The LORD spoke through Moses.
The LORD gave these commandments and ordinances on the plains of Moab.
The plains of Moab are by the Jordan River.
The Jordan River is across from Jericho.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֞ת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
